div.h1: Where Arabian heritage meets Kerala soul
div.p: An aesthetic cafe with multicuisine dishes and signature Arabian specialties: slow-cooked Kuzhimanthi, charcoal-seared Al Faham, freshly rolled shawarma, golden Turkish Kunafa and specialty coffee, in the heart of Kanjirappally.

div.h2: Handcrafted spices, charcoal embers & warm hospitality
div.p: On the Kottayam–Kumily highway at 26th Mile Bridge, Ayshu's Culinary Restaurant is built on a passion for authentic culinary traditions.

From slow-steamed Kuzhimanthi made with aged basmati and whole spices, to Al Faham seared over open coals, every recipe is prepared fresh daily. Stop for an artisan coffee in our cosy cafe lounge or gather the whole family for an evening feast: you will find warmth in every detail.
Freshly hand-ground Malabar spices, heritage dum techniques and authentic Arabian marinades.
Slow-steamed spiced basmati and charcoal-smoked tender chicken, with spicy tomato salsa & creamy garlic toum.
Chicken infused with freshly cracked Malabar black pepper, garlic & Arabic herbs, char-grilled over live embers with kuboos.
Jeerakasala kaima rice layered with slow-cooked chicken masala, golden fried onions and ghee, with raita & date pickle.
Crisp golden kataifi pastry stuffed with melted cheese, drenched in orange blossom syrup & pistachios.
Single-estate espresso pulled fresh with sweetened condensed milk and velvety micro-foam, served hot or iced.
Fresh elaneer pulp blended with thick dairy cream and vanilla ice cream: the ultimate cooler on the highway.
A quick coffee on the highway, a family feast, a celebration or a parcel for home: Ayshu's has a table for it.

a.p: Kuzhimanthi, Al Faham and Mandi from the charcoal pit, served piping hot to your table.
Specialty roasts, Spanish lattes, Kunafa and shakes in a calm, beautifully lit lounge.
A spacious AC family lounge with high chairs, birthday set-ups and private banquets for 10+ guests.
Parcel orders, bulk party catering and private lounge bookings, one call away.

div.p: Open 7 days a week for continuous all-day dining and takeout. Kitchen last order at 10:30 PM.
The midday rush for slow-steamed rice dishes, straight from the dum pot.
Coffee, rolls and something sweet as the highway lights come on.
The charcoal pit at full glow: our busiest, smokiest and most loved hours.
